warPlan.desc: Bartuc and the Fell Council have +1 Monster Power and drop additional items when slain.
At the start of the Infernal Hordes, gain an Infernal Challenge. Completing the Infernal Challenge will grant +200 Aether.
Chaos Waves appear more frequently. However, one less Infernal Offering appears each wave.
When you enter a Chaos Wave, gain +50 Aether and all enemies in the Infernal Hordes gain +1 Monster Power.
When the current wave has 10 seconds remaining, Aether Events spawn at all locations.
warPlan.seasonal: At Rank 14 with the Splinter of Terror, Impending Doom also triggers when the current wave has 30 seconds remaining.

warPlan.desc: Gem Fragments drop instead of Obducite in the Infernal Hordes.
Once per wave the Scale of Tathamet may appear, a primordial relic that kills all enemies within the Infernal Hordes.
Your Infernal Offerings are more likely to share a category with your previous choice.
Obducite drops instead of Gem Fragments in the Infernal Hordes.
Doomsayers appear during the Infernal Hordes. Doomsayers are dangerous enemies but also drop Aether.
warPlan.seasonal: At Rank 5 with the Splinter of Terror, a Doomsayer appears at the start of each wave.

warPlan.desc: An additional Infernal Offering appears each wave. However, you suppress Chaos Waves from appearing.
Suppressing a Chaos Wave grants +50 Aether. All enemies in the Infernal Hordes gain +1 Monster Power.
An ominous altar appears between waves in the Infernal Hordes. It can be invoked only once, and provides an Infernal Offering that shares a category with your previous choice.
The Chest of Talismans will appear after defeating either the Fell Council or Bartuc.
warPlan.seasonal: At Rank 20 with the Splinter of Terror, the Chest of Talismans now costs 1 Aether.

warPlan.desc: Defeating either the Fell Council or Bartuc reveals the Hoard of Greater Equipment, which contains a colossal deluge of equipment and other rewards.
